label: Connection
description: Connect your Square account. In the Square Developer Console (developer.squareup.com/apps), create an application, open its Credentials page, switch to Production and copy the access token. Paste it here, save, and press Test connection: it checks the token and registers the notices Square sends to this store. To try the app without touching your shop, use the Sandbox access token and choose Sandbox below.

fields.label: Test connection
fields.hint: Checks the saved access token with Square, lists the locations, and registers the notices Square sends to this store

actions.label: Sync now
actions.hint: Compares the stock of every linked item and looks for new Square sales now
